title: RNAseq of circulating CD34+ cells derived from TCIRG1-defective patients
description: Transcriptomic profile of CD34+ cells circulating in peripheral blood of TCIRG1-mutated osteopetrotic patients, compared to cord blood and mobilized CD34+ cells Overall design: Circulating CD34+ cells were isolated from peripheral blood of 6 TCIRG1 osteopetrotic patients, using microbeads. Commercially available cord blood (n=3) and mobilized peripheral blood CD34+ cells (n=3) were used as controls.
